name: Geostationary transfer orbit

name: Moon transfer
source: derived: 9,400 m/s surface->LEO incl. losses (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Delta-v_budget&oldid=1362285519 "about 9.4 km/s"; bracketed by Humble/Henry/Larson Table 2.10 via https://seitzman.gatech.edu/classes/ae4451/vehicle_acceleration.pdf) + 3,200 LEO->TLI (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Delta-v_budget&oldid=1362285519 Gateway table "3.20"; Apollo TLI 3.05-3.25 km/s)

name: Low lunar orbit
